profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer |  BPM | Automation and DevOps | E2E Automation Architect | SAFe
profile.summary:
20+ years of experience in  Software Testing as a seasoned  Leader and Engineer, who is flexible, detail oriented and skilled in Software Quality Assurance, Test Automation, E2E testing, Test Management, DevOps, Configuration & Release Management, Program / Project Management, Software Engineering and Testing Process.

•	Familiar with SAFe, Agile, Scrum, Kanban, feature driven, Waterfall, and RAD life cycle modal.
•	Experience in managing multi-million dollar programs and projects for Software Testing and Test Automation.
•	Managing and working with team of 20+ automation engineers and QAs in globally distributed teams
•	Resource allocation, tasks assignments and tracking efforts for major testing milestones
•	Experience in managing and working with contract resources and vendor management. 
•	Experience in leading multiyear programs, multiple projects and leading the global test teams.
•	Test planning, execution and managing test data setup & test environments.
•	Resource fulfillment, Task management, scheduling & estimation, defect management and release tracking.
•	Expertise in creating keyword driven and data driven framework for Selenium, UFT and Rational tool.
•	Testing of  Web Service, back end, Data Warehouse, Data analytics and BI solutions.
•	Building Continuous Integration for Test Automation using Jenkins, Maven and SVN/Git.
•	Creating and maintaining testing and automation infrastructure using PaaS Cloud. 
•	Deep knowledge of various aspects of Dev Ops, Automated Build, QA Automation & Test Data Provisioning.
•	Jenkins set up for CI - including node set up, remote/slave execution, Job configuration and management of Jobs for automation suites.
